value.title: Episodio 1
value.synopsis: Wu Daoying crede che i demoni esistano e rovinino la vita delle persone. In quanto guardia della città, indaga sulla scomparsa misteriosa di alcuni bambini, spariti durante la festa di Re Lingann. Un'importante rivelazione lo attende.

value.title: Episodio 2
value.synopsis: Wu Daoying si trova insieme alla sua nuova amica a combattere contro un'antica tartaruga. Il misterioso uomo che credeva essere responsabile della scomparsa dei bambini si unirà a lui per sconfiggere il pericolo e gli darà il coraggio di lasciare il suo ruolo.

value.title: Episode 3
value.synopsis: Wu Daoying hasn't been traveling for long with Qing Xuan, his new travel companion and teacher, and they already encounter two female bandits along their way. However, it seems the bandits are after more than just their valuables…

value.title: Episode 4
value.synopsis: Wu Daoying persuades Silberhorn to make a deal with him so that her wish can be fulfilled. But the plan unfolds very differently than she had imagined.

value.title: Episode 5
value.synopsis: Qing Xuan and Wu Daoying arrive in the city of Xi An, searching for the Sarira. But even here, things aren't going smoothly…

value.title: Episode 6
value.synopsis: Gelbbraue lures them all into a trap, and suddenly Wu Daoying finds himself trapped in an illusion that mirrors his sad past.

value.title: Episode 7
value.synopsis: At a rest area on the Tuoluo estate, Wu Daoying and Qing Xuan take a break until they unexpectedly receive information about the thief who stole the Sarira.

value.title: Episode 8
value.synopsis: Wu Daoying has formed a friendship with the shy Nine-Headed Phoenix and happily travels with Qing Xuan to the next city. There's a lot happening here due to the upcoming Ghost Festival, and Wu Daoying visits a temple with Qing Xuan to pray.

value.title: Episode 9
value.synopsis: The people of the city of Liangzhou are being attacked by the Soul-Eating Flower, and Qing Xuan separates from Wu Daoying. Desperately, he tries to stop the attack …

value.title: Episode 10
value.synopsis: Qing Xuan is led by the two demons, Qingfeng and Mingyue, to be the true culprit. However, Li Tang and Wu Daoying, who had followed him, cannot allow that…

value.title: Episode 11
value.synopsis: Qing Xuan is beaten by Zhenyuan, and Li Tang and Wu Daoying rush to his aid. But unfortunately, they can't do much either.

value.title: Episode 12
value.synopsis: The battle seemed hopeless until Wu Daoying uncovered Qing Xuan's secret. To escape the dire situation, Wu Daoying accepts the demon's offer, who lived inside the Wandermonk.
